uncertainty_band_audit.scope: Independent recalculation of every interval used by displayed task/adaptation/calibration plots in the two notebooks; plotting/numerical arrays unchanged.
uncertainty_band_audit.postprocessing: Only the declared sample quantiles, Student-t intervals, or exact binomial intervals; no smoothing, rescaling, minimum display width, or added jitter in shaded bands.
uncertainty_band_audit.important_distinction: Repeated simulation trials produce empirical spread and uncertainty in aggregate means/coverage; these bands are not posterior credible tubes or Monte Carlo integration error. Finite integration error is checked separately.

uncertainty_band_audit.reporting_scope: Adaptation values are pre-update estimates at sparse reporting times, not a dense trajectory between reports.

beamforming.clock: The adaptation table uses time_s=(t-1)*dt, with the first observation at zero.
beamforming.displayed_event_marker: First reporting checkpoint with changed generating variance; not the exact physical change time.
beamforming.source: Noise variance is multiplied by four at zero-based index T//2 in the saved-study generator; no stream is regenerated here.
beamforming.interpretation: Displayed estimates are pre-update checkpoint values. Step segments only connect those reports and must not be read as measurements or the exact variance-update trajectory between checkpoints.
